title: Cataloging security asks for onboarding using weighted heuristics
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous security and compliance asks during onboarding (SOC2 control requests, ISO evidence asks, HIPAA mappings, GDPR/DPA residency questions and vendor questionnaires). Current triage is manual, slow, and causes variable SLAs and duplicated evidence work. Goal: build a lightweight cataloging layer that converts free-text customer asks into a structured object (category, sensitivity, legal urgency, ARR impact) and assigns a priority lane plus a suggested response template and evidence bundle. The system should combine deterministic rules (keywords, onboarding form fields) and a weighted heuristic risk score to drive SLA lanes, as well as provide a human-in-the-loop review route for edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Extracted structured fields (category, subcategory, data_sensitivity, regulatory_domain, suggested_evidence) for >= 85% of a 200-sample historical set when compared to gold labels
Priority lanes produced (Fast-Path, Standard, Legal-Escalate) with mapping rules and SLA definitions documented in Confluence
Auto-suggested response templates appear in the intake UI for Fast-Path and Standard lanes and pre-fill 70% of required evidence links
Audit log captures classifier output, human overrides, timestamps and reviewer name for every triaged ask
Integration point (webhook/API) defined for downstream routing to PS, Security, or Legal teams and end-to-end test implemented
Operational telemetry surfaced in Console: volume by lane, median time-to-first-response by lane, manual override rate
tasks: Draft schema for security-ask object and priority lane mapping (PM + Security) - Confluence doc
Create labeling set from last 12 months of intake emails and questionnaires (sample 200) - Data team
Prototype classifier: rules + light-weight ML model and heuristic aggregator (ENG) - proof of concept
Design intake UI changes to show suggested lane, templates, and evidence bundle - Design
Implement webhook to route to PS/Security/Legal queues with audit metadata - ENG
Create response template library and evidence pack generator for common asks - PM + Legal
Instrument metrics and add Console dashboards for triage KPIs - Observability
Run dry-run on next 30 onboarding requests and refine thresholds before rolling to all accounts
decisions: Weighted heuristic will be primary signal; deterministic rules will override when matched explicitly (eg. 'HIPAA Business Associate' -> HIPAA lane)
Initial risk score formula: risk = 1.5*legal_impact + 2.0*data_sensitivity + 1.2*revenue_impact + 1.0*customer_urgency (scored 0-5); thresholds to be tuned post POC
Human-in-the-loop review step required for all items routed to Legal-Escalate lane
Start with minimal ML model (logistic regression/nb) to limit inference cost and simplify explainability; revisit if accuracy plateau

notes: Avoid over-automation for high-variance legal asks in first iteration. Focus on classification quality and a smooth override UX. Plan a retrospective after dry-run and include Legal for SLA tuning. Consider using Redwood Optimize insights (batching of similar asks) to suggest shared evidence bundles across accounts.
